notes: No duplicate-company precedent flagged for SR203 in the brief (this project's first Japan-market company). Access: plain requests/WebFetch timed out repeatedly on this Next.js SPA (muji.com/jp/ja/store, built v2.95.0, backed by a custom GraphQL BFF at /jp/ja/ec-bff/graphql, not Shopify) - curl_cffi impersonate='chrome124' succeeded (HTTP 200) and returned server-rendered nav + paginated product-tile HTML (40 items/page) for every category node, so no JS execution/browser automation was needed or used. The rendered 'N-in of 753' item-count footer some prior research suggested is client-hydrated and not present in the SSR HTML actually fetched, so qty for every row below was verified empirically per Rule 1: exhaustively paged each node via unique cmdty/detail product IDs until a short/empty page confirmed exhaustion, then title-audited every product name (translated JA->EN) to apply Rule 0 product-type scoping. Full nav surveyed: apparel/cosmetics/food/travel/stationery/bicycles/pets/cleaning/laundry/storage(D00016)/bedding(D00041)/furniture(D00019, incl. IDEE furniture T11010)/appliances(within D00021)/bath-toilet personal-care(T20035)/curtains-blinds-rugs-cushions(D00020 minus its インテリア雑貨 sub-node)/gardening tools & live plants(T40005/T40002 minus 2 unique planter SKUs)/home fragrance(D00045, plus 1 diffuser misfiled in Lighting) - all confirmed out-of-scope and excluded, no rows emitted. Rule 0 gains: Lighting and Clocks/Mirrors were both drilled out of a single mixed 'Appliances/Lighting/Clocks' nav node (D00021) and a mixed 'Interior Misc' node (T20008) respectively rather than excluded for being bundled with non-decor items. Rule 0.6: MUJI cross-lists many SKUs under a second 'IDEE' brand-facet nav path (T11010-T11012) that duplicates items already reachable via the functional category nodes below (IDEE lighting already in Lighting/T20033, IDEE clocks already in Clocks/S1070109, IDEE photo frame already in Mirrors&Frames/T20008, IDEE art posters already in Wall Art/T20040) - these were matched by product ID and NOT double-counted; the IDEE facet did surface 3 genuinely additional tray SKUs (Saza Tray S/M/L, no counterpart under the tableware node) which were added to Trays. The 'Found MUJI' curated line (D00036/T12001) was treated as a real permanent sub-catalog (like IDEE), not an inspiration/collection page, since its SKUs are genuine standalone products not duplicated elsewhere; it contributed 13 tableware/glassware SKUs and 19 figurine/ornament SKUs (wooden animal ornaments + wool-felt animal figurines), both merged into their product-type categories with dedup verified by product ID.
